headlines: Brazil-linked names crash premarket and into the open: XP -52%, NU -21%, EWZ -24%, MELI -11% (cause unconfirmed; posters cite a Brazil election result)
Posters say markets are rallying on Anthropic IPO/S-1 news
RDDT -5%, TSLA +6%, MRNA +1% on Stocktwits trending

rumors.text: Posters link the Brazil-linked crash (NU, XP, EWZ, MELI) to a leftist election win in Brazil
rumors.why: Political risk repricing in Brazil would hit Brazil-exposed names; little direct effect on SPY

rumors.text: Posters say the market is rallying on the Anthropic S-1 / IPO news, lifting AI-linked names
rumors.why: An AI IPO could support AI valuations, but the link to the index move is a poster guess

rumors.text: Poster claims oil is about to spike and that call buyers are being baited
rumors.why: An oil spike would add to inflation and yield pressure on equities

plays.reason: SPY up 0.5% with VIX falling while the crowd is extremely bearish (score 19); a crowded bearish bet leaves room for squeezes
plays.catalyst: Falling VIX, no major US data, AI/IPO chatter
